# Used by the on-demand Slurm job entrypoint (run_transcribe.py) to decode
# arbitrary input formats (m4a/mp4/mov/...) to WAV before handing audio to
# the model -- this deployment's libsndfile can't read those formats
# directly, and no system ffmpeg exists on this cluster. Same approach as
# ModelService_RVC-Applio/normalize_audio.py. Not needed by the legacy
# always-on app.py, which only ever received already-decoded WAV/MP3/etc.
